Trappola del valore, o value trap: un ti: Value trap: a stock that looks discounted but stays low because the business is getting worse. The signs: revenue and margins falling for years, with debts that keep rising.
Il valore contabile è quello scritto in: Book value is the one written on the balance sheet. It can understate a company with a strong brand, because brands and skills built in-house mostly do not appear in the accounts. If instead a stock trades below book value, check that the assets on the balance sheet are worth what is written and still produce profits.
Il mercato può ignorare a lungo un valor: The market can ignore for a long time a value that looks obvious to you. You need patience and money you will not need soon: years can go by.
